# Gramlot 0.3.2 — Containers and inspector

- Add borderContainer/contentPane with live splitters, legacy-style regions, reactive dimensions, nested rounded layouts and compact drawer handles. Labels and icons minimize together; themes control sizing, reveal and contrast.
- Add tabContainer and stackContainer with Data-bound selection and retained mounted panels. Tab mode, side, alignment, icons and badges are reactive; closing removes Source while preserving Data.
- Publish container selection, closing, drawer and splitter events for subscribed dataControllers.
- Extend the shared optional Inspector with Source insertion, deletion, drag/reparenting and conflict-aware Undo/Redo, locally and through its bridge. Parent component requirements are validated before edits.
- Consolidate parent/child parameter projection and support gallery composition with the shared containers; the core remains independent of examples and adapters.
- Add dedicated Inspector unit and browser suites to CI, including Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

Local verification: 3,559 JavaScript tests; 168 Python tests and 266 subtests (one existing expected failure); 39 Inspector unit tests; Chromium/WebKit container, theme, mobile and structural-edit qualification. Release CI must pass before publication. Local Firefox startup could not create its temporary profile; the Linux CI browser check is the release gate.
